title: Cleaner before E4 review supersedes E3 exploratory advancement
body: CONFIRMED: Audit of archived E2 window 74 frames found 11136 green proxy pixels-frame at feathered contaminated SOURCE boundaries and 4605 at rejected donors. Hard donor ablation leaves 4605 and seams; not an approved fix. E2 sequence uses LK partial affine, unlike local SIFT controls; control results cannot validate the different delivered path. E3 effective source/donor/model blend weights 2.954/73.424/23.622 percent, not binary 82.23/17.77 provenance or compute savings. ProPainter processed full 46-frame inference masks. New one-clock comparison videos contain 74 and 46 frames at30fps plus exact-frame PNGs. Manifest128 artifacts and code hashes verified. Status RETEST_BEFORE_E4 supersedes prior exploratory advancement in cleaner-e3-pedro-propainter-temporal-plus-observed-references-9d0e2a91dad1. HYPOTHESIS: donor/model weight switches at138/139/149 contribute temporal texture instability; no continuous/blind temporal approval, no compensated temporal gate. Browser webview attachment timed out. No new inference, paid GPU or production changes.
